x: The contest in the boys' section resolved itself into a duel between C.A.Page, 14½ yrs., and Derek Wade, 13½ yrs; the former winning by one point.

Young Wade, too, is beginning to make a name for himself, particularly in the jumps, and with Paddy Fyman,shot, Tony Moritz, discus 137 feet, and Chris Page,javelin, it appears that this side of athletics is being well taken care of.
